paragraphs: A-Frame Solutions sells ArcSuite AI, a no-code operations platform for federal, state, local and education agencies. Agencies use it to track work, evaluate vendors, compose documents and analyze data in one place, without developers.

Four integrated modules make up the suite, and a customer can use one or all four. ArcTracker holds configurable items, checklists, role-based access, relationships and rollups, and is the record every other module hangs off. ArcInsight is an assistant that answers plain English questions grounded in that tracker data. That assistant is powered by Claude on AWS Bedrock. ArcProcure covers solicitations, evaluations and contract management end to end, while ArcSelect is a multi-evaluator consensus platform for scoring or ranking decisions.

A-Frame Solutions was founded in 2014 by three former federal Contracting Officers. Its first contract was with the NOAA acquisition and grants office. The platform is available on GSA MAS Schedule 47QRAA18D003H. State agencies, counties, cities and special districts can buy it through the Purchasing Solutions Alliance cooperative with no competitive solicitation required. FedRAMP authorization is listed as in process. An IRS contract and an Authority to Operate brought ArcSuite AI into live federal production.
